lines: EndSpeech: Fiquei cego pela fumaça nos olhos.

list.text: Burying yourself in the hot sand helps with circulation.
It really helps alleviate joint pain.
Can your Pokémon withstand temperatures of 90 degrees?

lines: EndSpeech: Não fui quente o suficiente.

list.text: The magma's temperature is 600ºC. Your Pokémon beat me, so it must be able to survive the magma.
I'm trying to get rid of stress. Don't come here and stress me out even more!

lines: EndSpeech: Eu espero que as chamas de Flannery te queimem!

list.text: If you spend too much time resting, you won't be able to train later...

lines: EndSpeech: Oh, mas você é muito forte!

list.text: I’m going to be a beautiful and strong trainer, like Flannery.
\f[faceFlannery]\rPuny Trainer, you've done well to make it this far!
\f[faceFlannery]\rI'm Flannery, and I'm in charge here!
\f[faceFlannery]\rWith skills inherited from my grandfather, who was once one of the Elite Four, I'm going to demonstrate the hot moves I honed close to a volcano!

then.text: \f[faceFlannery]\rJust because you look up to somebody doesn't mean you have to be just like them.\nI can never be my grandfather.
\f[faceFlannery]\rI'm going to keep being myself from now on.
\f[faceFlannery]\rThank you for teaching me that. You deserve this.
\PN received the Heat Badge from Flannery!
\f[faceFlannery]\rIf you have a Heat Badge, all Pokémon from other regions up to Level 40, can be used in Hoenn.
\f[faceFlannery]\rThis is a token of my appreciation. Don't be shy about taking it!
\f[faceFlannery]\rHeat Wave is a Fire-type move that inflicts serious damage on the target, and it may also leave targets with a burn.

list.text: \f[faceFlannery]\rMy grandfather was one of the Elite Four, and I'd felt pressured to live up to that since I was little.
\f[faceFlannery]\rI tried to get stronger as fast as I could, but it seems I was just running in circles...
